snippet.title: Overtime Syndrome: A Late Night Shift Story - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
【Overtime Syndrome – A Night Shift Story】is a free to play, ultra-short horror game, coming soon on steam. If you like horror game, don't miss out this free game!

Experience "a night of overtime you’ve grown accustomed to" in this ultra-short horror game.But unlike the usual grind, the entire office tonight feels…off, ominous, and strange.Your coworkers are nowhere to be found. The lights are dim. And something — or someone — unknown is lurking.Can you make it until the end of your shift?

In this game, you take on the role of Max, an overworked corporate drone stuck on yet another late-night shift — only this time, something’s not quite right. Strange and unsettling events begin to unfold. As Max, you’ll try to finish your work and make it through the night… hopefully alive.

Wish list here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3918340
Follow Us on X: https://x.com/buffcatgames
